theorem mellin_comp_mul_left (f : ℝ → E) (s : ℂ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    mellin (fun t => f (a * t)) s = (a : ℂ) ^ (-s) • mellin f s := by
  simp_rw [mellin]
  have : EqOn (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f (a * t))
      (fun t : ℝ => (a : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) • (fun u : ℝ => (u : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f u) (a * t))
        (Ioi 0) := fun t ht ↦ by
    dsimp only
    rw [ofReal_mul, mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg ha.le (le_of_lt ht), ← mul_smul,
      (by ring : 1 - s = -(s - 1)), cpow_neg, inv_mul_cancel_left₀]
    rw [Ne, cpow_eq_zero_iff, ofReal_eq_zero, not_and_or]
    exact Or.inl ha.ne'

    integral_comp_mul_left_Ioi (fun u ↦ (u : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f u) _ ha,
    mul_zero, ← Complex.coe_smul, ← mul_smul, sub_eq_add_neg,
    cpow_add _ _ (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha.ne'), cpow_one, ofReal_inv,
    mul_assoc, mul_comm, inv_mul_cancel_right₀ (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr ha.ne')]

theorem coef_eq {N q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ((μ q : ℂ) / q.totient) ^ 3 * ∑ b ∈ TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset q, e (-(N * ((b : ℝ) / q))) =
      (coefN N q : ℂ) := by
  unfold coefN
  split_ifs with hsq
  · have hR := moebius_mul_ramanujan hsq N
    have hB : TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset q = (range q).filter q.Coprime := by
      unfold TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset
      exact filter_congr fun b _ => Nat.coprime_comm
    have hsum : ∑ b ∈ TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset q, e (-(N * ((b : ℝ) / q))) =
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ a ∈ (range q).filter q.Coprime, e (a * N / q)) := by
      rw [hB, map_sum]; refine sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      rw [← e_neg_eq_conj]; congr 1; ring
    have hconj : (μ q : ℂ) * ∑ b ∈ TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset q, e (-(N * ((b : ℝ) / q))) =
        ((∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, (1 - divW N p) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [hsum, show (μ q : ℂ) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (μ q) by simp, ← map_mul, hR, Complex.conj_ofReal]
    rw [div_pow, moebius_cube, div_mul_eq_mul_div, hconj]
    have ht : ((q.totient : ℕ) : ℂ) = ((∏ p ∈ q.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [← totient_of_squarefree hsq]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [ht]
    unfold aP
    rw [prod_div_distrib, prod_pow]
    push_cast; ring
  · rw [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree hsq]; simp

proof_context.conclusion: $(\mu(q)/\phi(q))^3\sum_{b\in Bset\ q} e(-Nb/q)=\mathrm{coefN}(N,q)=\prod_{p|q}a_p(N)$, the Ramanujan-sum coefficient (equal to $\mu(q/(q,N))\phi((q,N))\mu(q)^3/\phi(q)^3$ for squarefree $q$).

theorem cor_12_2_5 {x δ₀ Q₀ : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)

      (Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 2) / (Real.log (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) + cE) * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
  set Q := √(x / (2 * δ₀)) with hQdef
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by positivity) hx
  have hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hx
  refine prop_12_1_2 ha hδ₀ (by linarith) ?_ fun q hq _ hq2 s hs hsq => ?_
  · have h1 : Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by nlinarith) hx
    have h2 : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith)
    have h3 : δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = x / 2 := by field_simp

  have hLQ : 0 < Real.log Q + cE := by
    have : 0 < Real.log Q := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    unfold cE; linarith

  set R := Q₀ / (s * q) with hRdef
  rcases le_or_gt 22000000000 q with hbig | hsmall

  · -- `q < 2.2·10¹⁰`: the reduction to `Φ`

theorem sum_ΛBad_le (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), ΛBad n ≤ psi N - theta N + Real.log 2 := by
  classical
  have hsplit : psi N - theta N = ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), if n.Prime then 0 else Λ n := by
    rw [psi, theta, ← sum_sub_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have hlog2 : ∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), (if n = 2 then Real.log 2 else 0) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    rw [sum_ite_eq' (range (N + 1)) 2 (fun _ => Real.log 2)]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  rw [hsplit]
  refine le_trans ?_ (add_le_add le_rfl hlog2)
  rw [← sum_add_distrib]
  refine sum_le_sum fun n _ => ?_
  unfold ΛBad Good
  have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  by_cases hp : n.Prime
  · by_cases ho : Odd n
    · simp only [hp, ho, and_self, ite_true]
      split_ifs <;> linarith
    · have : n = 2 := (hp.eq_two_or_odd').resolve_right ho
      subst this
      simp [hp, ho, vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
  · simp only [hp, false_and, ite_false, ite_true]
    split_ifs <;> simp [vonMangoldt_nonneg, h2]
